name: LastPass
description: LastPass is a password manager and digital vault that stores and autofills login credentials, using zero-knowledge encryption so LastPass itself cannot access users' stored passwords.
best_for: The vendor targets individuals, families (up to 6 members), small teams/startups, small-to-medium businesses, enterprises, and Managed Service Providers (MSPs).
features: Single sign-on (SSO) and MFA for business tiers

alternatives.name: 1Password
alternatives.description: Market-leading password manager for businesses and families.
alternatives.best_for: Teams wanting proven security architecture and Travel Mode

alternatives.name: Bitwarden
alternatives.description: Open-source password manager with transparent zero-knowledge security.
alternatives.best_for: Privacy-focused users and developers wanting open-source software

alternatives.name: Keeper
alternatives.description: Zero-knowledge password vault and privileged access management platform.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses requiring certified zero-trust password infrastructure
